live.title: Use your real {{product}} data?
live.message: This preview will open the same data folder and keychain items as the installed {{product}} app and its command-line tool. Syncing here changes that data. Opening the folder may also update the format of its database; an older installed {{product}} would then ask to be updated before it opens your data again.
